summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of GitFable Arcane Terminal UI revamp - ALL TESTS PASSING. Tested landing page, login flow, discover filters/draw/bookmark flows, dashboard, leaderboard tabs, history, public profile navigation, and complete PR submission/verify flow.

issues: Minor accessibility warning: Missing aria-describedby on login and PR dialogs (console warning only, not blocking)

passed_tests: Landing page: Hero CTA, leaderboard button, how-it-works, stats, activity feed, bottom CTA, footer all render correctly
Navigation: All nav links (Discover, Dashboard, Leaderboard, History) present and functional
Login flow: Modal opens, username input works, submit creates user and navigates to discover
User menu: Profile, Dashboard, Logout dropdown items all present and clickable
Discover page: Language filters (10 languages), difficulty filters (3 levels) toggle correctly
Draw issue flow: Card shuffle animation, issue reveal with repo/title/language/difficulty/stars/labels
Bookmark flow: Bookmark button creates active bookmark, 7-day countdown, Submit PR/GitHub/Release buttons appear
PR submission flow: Dialog opens, URL input, submit works with +25 XP toast
Verify merge flow: Button appears after PR submit, verification awards +100 XP and badges
Dashboard: Profile card, XP progress, streak indicator, stats grid, badges grid (10 badges), contribution heatmap, recent draws
Leaderboard: Podium (top 3), tabs (Weekly/Monthly/All-Time), table with rank/author/level/XP/contribs/streak
Leaderboard row click: Navigates to public profile page correctly
History page: Stats (total draws, bookmark rate, merge rate), status filters (all 6), empty state message
Profile page: Header (avatar, name, level, join date, XP), stats, badges, recent chapters
Mobile responsive: Landing adapts well, mobile bottom nav appears for logged-in users
No runtime errors on any page
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add aria-describedby to DialogContent in Navbar.js login dialog and Discover.js PR dialog to fix accessibility warnings
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend UI revamp fully verified. All pages load correctly, all interactive flows work (draw, bookmark, PR submit, verify). Mock authentication and APIs working. Next step per user request is real GitHub integration.
